note: max is the phase 6 budget. ceiling is where today's code fails the gate. Issue #52 tightened the idle ceilings to about twice what the 30-minute run reached, since a 30-second window under other builds moves with how many processes start and end. The CPU a tick is the mean of the whole process's CPU from one sample to the next. Its ceiling went from 30 to 40 ms when the menus' prepare step joined each tick: a 30-second window under load read 30.27 ms, while the 30-minute run read 14.5 ms. The cold scan's ceiling is twice its 30-second budget, since one run at a load average of 81 took 74 seconds. The warm scan's ceiling is twice its 2-second budget, since a run at a load average of 148 read 2.57 seconds while its CPU stayed near 0.3 seconds. MM_BENCH_STRICT=1 gates on max. docs/2.0/BENCH.md has the numbers behind the idle ceilings, docs/2.0/MEASUREMENTS.md those behind the menu ceilings.
